dispute.statement: I agreed to the road he named, but he says himself he went a different way. The fare was much higher than the estimate.

chat.text: Jam on Kallang Paya Lebar Expressway is building up ahead, can I go round via Upper Paya Lebar Road?

driver_statement: I asked the rider about going via Upper Paya Lebar Road and the rider agreed. In the end I went by Hougang Avenue 3 instead because it looked clearer; same direction.
